entry.name: defaultDesktopMode
entry.label: Default mode for startup/new desktop (Ctrl+Shift+F1: 0=tiled, 1=KWin tiling, 2=float all, 3=maximize all)

entry.name: defaultPresetIndex
entry.label: Default ratio preset for startup/new desktop (Ctrl+Shift+F2: 0=1.5:1.5, 1=2.0:2.0, 2=3.0:3.0, 3=1.0:1.0)

entry.name: autoRetileMode
entry.label: Default auto-retile mode (Ctrl+Shift+F3: 0=off, 1=tiled only, 2=always)

entry.name: decorationMode
entry.label: Default window decorations mode (Ctrl+Shift+F4: 0=tiled borderless/floating bordered, 1=all bordered, 2=all borderless)

entry.name: autoLayoutOnDesktopChange
entry.label: Automatically retile after switching virtual desktop

entry.name: autoLayoutOnNewWindow
entry.label: Automatically retile when new window appears on current desktop

entry.name: autoLayoutOnWindowClose
entry.label: Automatically retile after closing a window on current desktop

entry.name: autoLayoutOnWindowMinimize
entry.label: Automatically retile after minimizing a window on current desktop

entry.name: autoLayoutOnWindowRestore
entry.label: Automatically retile when restoring a minimized window

entry.name: tileEvenIfNewMaximized
entry.label: Tile new windows even if they start maximized
entry.whatsthis:
If enabled, newly opened windows will be tiled even if they start maximized.
Only applies in "tiled-only" mode. In "always" mode, this setting has no effect.

entry.name: overflowBehavior
entry.label: When windows exceed limit (0=float, 1=least busy, 2=forward least busy, 3=empty/new desktop)

entry.name: ignoreTransientWindows
entry.label: Ignore transient/modal windows (dialogs)

entry.name: ignoreWordsTiling1
entry.label: Words to ignore from tiling (comma separated) – set 1

entry.name: ignoreWordsCycling1
entry.label: Words to ignore from cycling (Ctrl+Esc) (comma separated) – set 1

entry.name: doubleTapThresholdMs
entry.label: Double-tap detection threshold (ms)

entry.name: reorderSlotThreshold
entry.label: Minimum overlap ratio to accept drag-reorder (0.0–1.0)

entry.name: gapBetweenWindows
entry.label: Gap between tiled windows (pixels)

entry.name: screenMargin
entry.label: Margin from screen edges (pixels)

entry.name: autoLayoutOnActivityChange
entry.label: Automatically retile after switching activity

entry.label: Snapshot slot 1 (text payload)

entry.name: SLOT_2
entry.label: Snapshot slot 2 (text payload)

entry.name: SLOT_3
